tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsar rnying gi brda'i rnam dbye legs par bshad pa gsung rab kun la lta ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ shrī wan gu ru mañdzu badzra ye na ma/ bod skad du/ dpal ldan bla ma 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun bla ma mchog dang dbyangs can bdag /gnyis med zhabs la spyi bos gus btud nas/ /snyigs dus skad gnyis smra ba'i gtsug gi rgyan/ /zha lu lo chen chos skyong bzang po yi/ /thugs kyi sras mchog smin grub lo tsā bas/ ngag dbang rin chen bkra shis dpal bzang po/ /mdzad pa'i gsar rnying brda yi khyad par rnams/ /ston byed legs bshad li shi'i gur khang la/ /skad gnyis sbyar ba'i mchan bu yod med dang / /tshig sna ring thung 'dra min 'ga' snang ba/ /phan tshun zhus dag bgyis pa'i legs bshad gtam/ /gsung rab kun la lta ba'i sgron me 'di/ /blo gsal yongs kyi dga' ston nyid du spel/ /de yang 'dir brda sam̐ ka ta/ gsar na wa/ rnying pu rā ṇa/ gi tha snyad bshad pa thu mi sambho ṭa lho gnyal pa thu mi snang grags kyi bu a nu ste sambho ṭa dang / sambha dra sogs rgya skad du bzhed pa byung yang / sa 'bor po zhig 'dug pas sa 'bor rang yin pa 'dra/ gang nang bod skad du snang ngo / /dang / btsad po khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus dang por byas pa'i 'gyur rnams ni dang po'i bkas bcad kyis bsgyur ba ste/ lung sde bzhi dang mdo sde kha cig dang / sher phyin gyi mdo kha cig ste skad gsar bcad kyis gtan la phab pa rnams so/ /de la ni gang la gag dang / yaḥ ci phyir la ji rob dang / kamasmā ta/ ji snyam la ji ltar dang / ya thā/ rtse mo la spyi mo dang / urdhan/ shin tu'am rab tu la te por dang / a dyartha zhes pa'i bhram̐ shi/ yang wā dham̐ zhes pa bsgyur ba'i te bor ni dam pa dang / sra ba dang / drag pa dang / drag pa dang tshabs che ba rnams la 'jug pa dang /

rkyen sman la rkyen pra tya o ṣa dhi/ rtsi dang / ltag pa la/ glag kṛ kā ṭi ka pa dang / spos dhu pa/ dang spos phor la/ dhu pa ka ṭatstshu/ pog dang pog phor dang / bsal ba ni rā kṛ ta/ la bstsal ba dang / sogs ā di/ pa la stsogs pa dang / bsu ba la bstsu ba dang / pra dhud ma na/ dri bsung la a mo da/ dri bstsungs dang / bsangs pa la bstsangs pa dang / rdzogs so sa māsta/ la rdzogs s+ho dang / g.yogs pa la yogs pa dang / tstshā da ya mā pa/ go cha la ṇarma'am nāddha/ go ca dang / brag pra ti bru ta/ cha la brag ca dang / rin po che la ratna/ rin po ce dang / dkon ratna/ mchog la dkon cog dang / rin chen la rin cen dang / khyim gṛ ha/ la sdum pa dang / dbus la ma dhya/ la dbung dang / 'gro pa ti/ ba la 'gom pa dang / grub siddha/ pa la red pa dang / 'grel bṛtti/ pa la 'grol bar bsgyur ba sogs shin tu mang bar yod de/ rgyas par na gsung rab rnams su blta'o/ /yang de dag tu da drag dang / dpyid bla ra ba sogs de' la' ni' zhes pa lta bu mtha' rten sbyar ba ni sum rtags kyi dgongs pa don la thob pa gzhir bcas nas yi ge nyung ba'i slad du bzhag pa dang / yang myed dang myid sogs ya btags pa dang / ral gri la ral gyi sogs ni lo tsā ba kha cig gi yul skad shor bar grags pa yin no/ /gnyis pa skad gsar bcad la ni de dag gi zlas drangs pa ji skad bshad pa rnams dang / gzhan yang gsung rab la grags pa'i ming phal che ba rnams so/ /bkas bcad gnyis pa ni mnga' bdag khri ral pa yan chad du ka cog zhang gsum la sogs pas mdzad pa yin no/ /bkas bcad gsum pa ni lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyi dus kyi sgra bsgyur gyi lo tsā ba chen po rin chen bzang po nas/ dpang lo tsā ba chen po dang / snyigs dus kyi skad gnyis smra ba gcig pu ba lo chen dharmā pā la bhi dra'i bar du byon pa rnams yin la/

lo chen rin chen bzang po/ gyis ni nyi zla la gnyi zla dang / bstan bcos la bstan 'chos dang / stug po la 'thug po dang / nyi shu dang sum cu dang sum brgya rnams la gnyis bcu dang gsum bcu dang gsum brgya dang / bsam gtan la bsam brtan sogs 'chos par mdzad kyang / bkas bcad bar ba bzhin du gnas pa mang zhing / de'i brda'i khyad par gsung rab rnams su 'byung ba 'di snyed cig mchis te/ kwa he/ dang gag yaḥ ni skye dang gang / skyor skyor ni mu hurmu huḥ yang yang / bla 'og ni urdhā dhaḥ steng 'og bla skyal ba ni a bya ya/ mi zad pa/ rtsa lag ni bandhu/ gnyen/ gnya' bo ni pākṣa/ dpang po/ rid pa gṛ ṣa/ dang sbeg pa ni gṛ sha dngos ngan pa dang sha chung ba'am skem par/ gya ba ni naṣṭa/ nyams pa/ gyag pa ni ma thu ra/ brlag pa/ ye 'byams ni shu n+ya ta/ stong nyid/ dbal ni ke tu/ tog dang rtse mo dang / sha nyams dang me'i drod/ ngo ga ni snang ngo / gam̐ yo ni ni ka ṭa/ nye 'khor/ dmyus byung ni tshi tshad dam yi chad/ then tsher ni ce re/ ga zha ni hā sa/ bzhad bgad kyi sgra/ ya lad ni warmi ta/ go cha spyi dang / skabs thob kyi rmog gi ming la 'jug pa'ang yod/ gna' ni pra ma tha/ thog ma'am sngon/ yod do cog dang 'gyur ro cog lta bu'i cog ni mtha' dag gi don/ gyur cig gu lta bu'i gu ni smon pa'i tshig sbrebs pa ni shuṣka/ skems pa/ gsang khung ni bshang lam/ mdung dor ni dyu ta/ rgyan 'gyed/ cham du ni sarba tra/ gtan du/ nod pa ni labdha/ thob pa'am bzhag tha tshig ni i dyartha/ tshig gi don/ bsti ba la ni ya ti/ ngal gso ba/ brnag pa ni sam̐ kalpa/ bsam pa/ smyang ba ni pra ti sa dya/ brkyang ba/ nam zhar ni ka tā pi/ yang / 'on tang ni a si ta/ 'on kyang / bkri ba ni ne ya/

drangs pa'i khrid pa/ dbrag ni anta ra/ bar/ gzags pa ni pyanda/ zags pa/ phyam phyad ni pa la tā/ mnyam nyid/ bgro ba ni sang gī ti/ gleng ba/ rma ga chad ni a bla tampa ka yang dag pa'am phal po che dang snyan gyi gong rgyan/ bstar kuṇṭi ya/ ba sems la sgom dang yod pa la'ang 'jug ni ji dor legs dang bzabs pa spras pa dang / gting phyin ni anta ga dpyis phyin pa/ bro ni sha pa tha/ mna'/ chang khyu ni pa yū ha/ tshogs pa/ spa lo ni pra ti bhā na/ spobs pa/ tha ram̐ ni kha la/ ngan pa/ dbye ni sd+yā li/ thang / brnyang ba ni a ti sha ra/ 'khru ba/ bsnyil ba ni na sha nī ya/ dor ba'am phyir bskrad pa/ mthong ga ni pa rā bi/ brang / glam ni sd+yū la kalpa la/ snab bu 'thug po/ lag pa bsnyal ba ni lag pa dkrus pa/ khra khro can ni ka ṭu na/ spro thung ba/ mtho nan ni pra tha ma/ thog ma/ rung khus za ba ni tsaṇṭa/ gtum pa/ je ni ā di/ dang po dang re shig ces pa la'o/ /gzhi bo ni ā dhā ra/ gzhi ma/ ji 'os ni 'tshams pa/ gnong mi bkur ba ni a na bhyu pa ga ma/ nyes pa khas mi len pa/ bsgo ba rnar gzon pa ni la dzñā bi he tha na/ bsgo ba la mi nyan pa/ 'chab ba ni gupta/ gsang ba'am sbed pa/ 'dzan dka' ni duryo ga sbyor dka'/ 'khu ba ni dro ha/ zhe sdang ba/ bcabs pa ni gupti ta/ sbas pa/ gya tshom ni sā ha sā/ ma brtags pa/ rna blag ni shru te ya/ rna ba gtod pa/ tha chad ni ku ṭi la/ ngan pa/ stsel ba ni ni rā kṛ ta/ sel ba/ 'phye ba ni bhu dza/ 'gro ba/ smrang tshig ni guhya lwa tsa/ gsang tshig dang smra ba tsam la'ang 'jug go /smreng ba ni bā dī/ smra ba/ smre ba ni pa ri de ba ga ngan pa smra ba/ smre sngags durwakya/ kyang de nyid do/ /rmas pa pa ni pṛtsaṇa /

dris pa/ mi 'jab pa ni pa ru ṣa/ rtsub pa/ dral ba ni bi ga ta/ bcom pa'am zhig pa/ bla thang ni uta dhwa dha/ stod smad dam phyi nang / bsod pa ni pra ṇi ra/ bzang po'am legs pa/ bstabs pa ni darta/ brims pa'am byin pa/ bstab pa ni dā nā/ 'grem pa'am ster ba/ byer ba ba ni ga ta/ song ba/ brta ba ni rgyas par bya ba/ brtas pa ni sphī ta/ rgyas pa/ de ko ni i dā tī ma/ da ni/ 'di ko ni i dam̐/ 'di ni/ bkon pa ni krū ra/ khro ba/ ji ka ni brtag pa/ khyo shug ni dzasma tī/ bza' 'tsho/ gzhol ba ni 'bab pa/ nyis na ni rnam pa gnyis/ su na zhes pa lta bu yang na ba/ tha ba ni stam bha/ rengs pa/ mthar gyi ni enta na/ rim gyis/ gzhar yang ni nam yang dang slar yang / mnos pa ni ā sha yi ta/ bsam pa/ gya nom pa ni bha yaṅka ra/ phun sum tshogs pa/ pra ṇī ta snang ba'i skad dod pu tri sha yod pas legs pa'i don kyang yin no/ /phyad par ni gta tan/ rgyun par/ bsnams pa ni dha ra/ thogs pa/ shang dag ni sha stag 'jud pa ni warta ri/ 'jug pa/ rngub pa ni 'dus pa'am 'jug pa/ tsham rngam ni 'jigs stangs/ bab bab sa dha sā/ bam bcol ni ka ta si/ ma bsam par smra ba'am 'phral ba/ phyang yar ni phrin las/ snam logs ni zur dang rgyab bsgrel/ bya dya ra/ gzhi ni logs sam 'phred dam 'chol ba go rim bu mi gnas pa/ nyos pa ni anda/ zas/ rod pa ni bā sa/ gos/ yongs sarba tha/ ye ni rnam pa thams cad kyi thams cad du zhes pa lta bu'ang yin no/ /nges par ram rnam pa kun tu/ bstir med ni a wi tsi/ mnar med dam ngal gso med pa/ sbribs pa ni kṣubdha/ ltogs pa/ bru ba tsha ba ni kṣu dhi ta/ bkres pa/ bas krarsan/ pa kat+sahya/ ni bas pa dge slong gis kyang bgyi bar dka' de lta bu/

zad pa'am mtha' dag pa/ brtan pa ni chos thams cad thugs su chud ces pa ni lta bu rgyu dang he bsgyur ba/ nges gzung / ram̐ shag ni bhu ta/ 'byor ba/ mnangs pa ni bho ga nom pa'am srid/ mtha' gru dang tha gru ni be su mya/ rgya khyon/ mnab rtsal ni bho dza na/ kha zas/ g.yer po ni pa ṭu/ mkhas pa'am grims pa/ khos rang chab mi 'tshal ba ni tstshanda a wi nā sha 'dun ma chud mi za ba/ ji rob ni kasmā/ ci phyir/ bskyud pa ni sma sammo ṣa/ brjed pa pa/ khad kyis ni dal bus/ byur ni mañtsha/ mya ngan/ yol go ni pā tra/ snod/ bsnyengs pa ni bha ya/ 'jigs pa/ bsnyems pa ni garbha dang darba/ nga rgyal/ yug pa dang yob yob ni pā da dang / tsa ra ṇa dang / aṃ hri dang / aṃ ghri zhes pa rnams so/ /rkang pa/ sug pa ni hasta dang / pā ṇi/ lag pa/ nem nur ni bi tsi kit+sa/ yid gnyis/ rgya cang ni aṣkuñtsa kaṃ ska rags/ gor bu ni tsa tu ra pra ka gru bzhi/ gyi na dang gyin 'da' ni hī na da dang a nartha/ dman pa'am don med dam rang bzhin pa/ brtad pa ni atpi kā/ glo bur/ mi yog ni a tshā da nā/ mi khebs 'ubs pa ni sa mā dza/ 'dus pa/ khud pa ni yau ta kam̐ skyems rdzongs/ slags pa ni byu na/ bkod pa/ phyang chad ni ni ya ma/ thag chad/ la gor ni dza ba dang la hu/ mgyogs pa'am skyen pa/ mur 'dug ni tīrba/ mu stegs/ co 'dri ni ma ḍamwa ha/ tho 'tsham/ gzher ba ni se wi ta/ bsten pa/ yel 'phyos ni yu ga gaddha/ zub gam/ 'du 'phrod ni sa mā gri/ tshogs pa/ phya le ba pā ta/ mnyam pa/ chib pa ni byān/ khyab pa/ khos pa ni tstshanda/ 'dun pa/ mol ba ni ka tham̐/ gtam mam gros/ do thon ni pra sa bāau/ nan gyi/ tshud mo mkhan ni kha ta ru pa ka du/ rkos mkhan/

go 'dun ni goṣṭha/ tshogs shing 'du ba/ gzhur brtag ni zur za ba/ nyer bsdogs ni sā manta ka sta gon/ nyag phran ni shwa ra/ mda'/ gor ma chag pa ni niḥsam̐ she ya'am/ sa ṣā ṇa bhaṅga/ the tshom med pa/ gor ma gor ma ho ste ho bcag pa'i don/ bkum pa dang de nyid do/ /gnam ru ni dha bu'am tsā pa/ gzhu/ sprug pa ni kṣa ya/ zad pa/ bkar btags ni khrims bsgrags pa/ phung krol ni a nartha/ don med/ lhags pa ni smarī ta/ gtad pa/ phyar bi kṣe sa/ g.yeng ni rang nyid kyis 'dod pa'i chos gzhan la ngom zhing sgeg pa'i don kyang yin no/ /rnam g.yeng / sgam pa ni gam bhī ra/ zab pa/ bgam pa ni nyams sad pa/ mnabs pa ni wasatri ta/ gyon pa/ rtseg log ni kṣu dra/ phran tshegs sam sred zhen che ba/ tshar phyin ni sā ga ra/ mthar phyin/ dbab pa ni ā be sha 'bebs pa'am bzhag pa/ gzas pa ni urbhu ra ṇa/ brdeg par brtsams pa/ phon po ni sa mū ha/ tshogs pa/ 'dzer ba ni ā ha/ smras pa'am zer ba/ 'chel ba ni pakṣa'am ā mam̐ ba/ zhen pa'am 'chang ba/ tha rams ni pārṇa/ gtams pa/ phyis bu ni bhā dza na/ snod/ rtse phyibs ni anta ga mthar phyin/ glal ba ni bi dz-i bha/ kha gdangs sam rnam par bsgyings pa/ klubs pa ni phub pa'am gyon pa/ g.yem pa ni kā ma/ 'dod pa/ mu cor ni mu kha ra/ kha zer ba dang kha drag pa/ gnam po ni ārdza wa/ drang po/ 'khor zug ni tsakra wa ra/ 'khor yug chabs gcig pa ni smardham̐/ lhan cig pa/ chub pa ni bo dhi/ rtogs pa/ go 'dun ni nā nā/ sna tshogs sam gang mos/ mong du chud pa ni a wa ga ti/ khong du chud pa/ rlibs pa ni bi pu la/ rgya che ba/ mchil pa ni aṅku sha lcags kyu/ lcags kyo zhes pa'ang de nyid do/ /'gyed pa ni kau gṛ tya/

'gyod pa/ zang ā mi ṣa/ zing na zang zing gi sbyin pa gtso bor sha ster ba'i don du bshad do/ /sha'am zas/ 'gyer ba ni sardzan/ spong ba/ ger ma ni au tā ti ka rags ma/ rum ni kukṣa/ lto ba'am phag phom pa ni gha ṭa/ bum pa/ tron pa ni pra ti sa ra ṇa/ 'dod pa'am rjes su 'brang ba/ 'phyo ba ni bisla wa/ lding ba/ 'gems pa ni nā shi ra/ 'joms pa/ snyugs su ni ā yā ma/ yun du/ dbrog pa ni ha ra/ 'phrog pa/ gleb pa ni nī kranta/ mnan pa/ rjen pa ni naksha'am a tse lang 'dug gcer bu'am rkyang pa/ gal gyi ni nan gyis sam rgyal gyis/ bstu/ 'jen pa ni yid la 'thad pa dang rna bar 'thad pa lta bu la 'jug dngos po/ rlugs ni bi tikta/ lug pa ste zas ma zhu ba phyir byung ba/ nongs pa ni do ṣa/ nyes pa/ 'phye bo ni u ra ga gong po'am yan lag med par lto bas 'gro ba/ tshur sheg ni e hi/ tshur shog lce brten ni bya pa de sha brjod pa'am snyad 'dogs pa/ srib pa ni tstshā ri ta/ bsgrib pa'am grib ri dang mtshan mo/ slog pa ni tsarma/ pags pa'i gos/ sngod pa ni kṣi pa/ 'phen pa/ khol ma'am ba glang mig ni ga wakṣa/ skar khung / 'dir dkar gsal zer ba dang mun dkar zer ba dang bstun na das phul thob pa ltar snang yang skar tshod lta ba'i re'u mig bzhag pa las btags pa'i brda btsan par byas pa'o/ /'grems pa ni 'gyed pa/ gseg shang dang gsil byed ni khakkha ra dang sikkha ri yang zer/ khar sil/ spyi gtor can ni uṣṇi ṣa/ gtsug tor can/ gsong por smra ba ni purbā bhi lā bī/ sngar smra ba'am drang por smra ba/ do ker can ni aṣṇi ṣa/ thor cog can/ dpe 'khyud ni muṣṭi/ chos ston 'os pa la'ang sba/ khu tshur sba ba lta bu dper byas pa'o/ /'geb pa'i gtam dang bka' mchid ni pām̐ ka thyam̐/

yang dag pa'i gtam/ 'khyud dpyad ni muṣṭi ka ya/ mnyam bzhag phran bu sbas te 'chad pa/ mur thug pa ni saryanta/ mthar thug phol ba ni bo dha/ rtogs pa/ la bzlas ni ni ya ma/ thag bcad pa/ la zlo ni ni ya ma/ mtha' 'gegs pa'am thag gcod pa/ mi cha ba ni a dzñā na/ mi shes pa/ cha med ni rgyus med/ gtol med pa ni thabs med pa'am rgyus med pa/ ci gar ni ya thā/ ji ltar/ cis phyin ni anta ga mthar byin/ gar cig ni maḥ gang zhig smyan ka ni pām̐ tsa ri ta/ gnyen ka 'bags pa ni nā shi ta/ nyams pa/ dmun pa ni dza ḍa/ blun pa/ sho be ni mi thya/ rdzun shob kyang de nyid do/ /shid zan ni shrārdha dai na/ ro zas sam gshin zas/ shid ni gshin po la dmigs te dge ba bsgrub pa/ phru ma ni ni kṣisti ta/ pho brang ngam dmag sgar/ spong pa ni kṝ ḍa sd+ya/ rtse pa/ brtun pa ni ā tā pī/ brtson pa/ sgo 'phar ni ka pā ṭa/ sgo glegs/ spyos pa ni kro dha/ sdig pa'am khros pa/ snyom pa ni rant+ri/ g.yel ba/ dbye tshong ni kṛ tā gā ta/ tshong / thang la ni sam̐ kā+-irṇa/ bkram pa/ bslan pa ni ni kṣasta ta/ bsdus 'grel pa don gsal du de'i phyogs su bslan pa zhes pa lta bu/ pa'am phyogs gtogs/ tshogs phor ni pūrṇa/ rdzogs par/ bdar ba ni bcad pa'am gzhogs pa/ gzengs pa ni utte dza na/ brkyangs pa'am gzi byin/ 'cheg pa ni bhaṅga/ 'jigs pa/ glos pa ni mo hā/ rmongs pa/ smeg med ni ā sarba da/ gtan med/ g.yen spyo ni bi ḍamwa ya ri/ co 'dri ba'am sdang bar byed pa/ g.yam ni pra saṅga/ zhar/ rmed pa ni a dhye ya/ gsol ba/ slong phor ni pā tra/ lhung bzed/ bya ma rta ni a wa tsa ra ka nyan rna'am bang chen/ bro 'tshal ba ni ro za/ nad pa/ da bur ni sreg gnas/

bsel ba ni a nu ga ma na/ skyel ma/ gtsug lag ni arṣa/ sde snod/ bsod nams ni pu khalli kā/ 'dod pa la lhag par longs spyod pa'i ming / bsnyad pa ni ā khyā ta/ bshad pa/ bstsang ba ni bsang ba/ go re ni rdzogs pa/ brlang po ni pa ru ṣa/ rtsub mo/ gzhogs stegs ni aṅgi ta/ zur mig gam sgeg chos/ shur bu ni ka ṇi bandha/ ska rags/ 'dzan mo ni be shya/ bgrod bya ste bud med/ 'jud 'thun dang 'dod 'gro ni dā ri kā/ smad 'tshong / la gi sla ni pa ti/ las de dang de la bskos pa/ 'dzan pho ni be sha ka bgrod byed de skyes pa/ ska rags phog gu can ni katstshā ha ra/ ska rags rgyan can/ 'thab krol ni gnod rgyud 'gre ba ni ka lpi/ g.yo ba/ lcags phod ni ska rags kyi rgyan/ khong snyoms pa ni yid mi dga' ba'am sgyid lug pa/ dkyus mo ni 'gyongs pa'am rgyug pa/ dang la ni puṣka ri/ rdzing bu/ klab pa ni kampa la/ la ba/ dam̐ dya ni khrim/ zha sgre ni rna med/ ltag sgreng ni ltag ther/ gor mo ni kro dhi/ sdang sems/ sna sgrang ni mde'u/ 'bug pa ni utstsha ya/ bslang ba/ pus mkhyud ni yo ga paṭṭa/ sgom thag g.yar ni mu kha kha'am gdong ngam mdun/ hwags ni khaṇḍa/ bu ram gyi dwangs ma'am sha kha ra/ gal la zhes kyang 'grel pa zla zer du/ grags pa/ thags ran ni rant+ra/ btags pa/ smas pa ni gard+ya/ nyams pa/ ngan ni sd+yā na/ mthungs/ dngar ni siṅkti/ gral lam phreng ba/ gsug pa ni bhṛ tya/ rngan pa/ brngan zhes pa ni mchod pa/ rnam 'dal ni rnam 'dud/ 'gyed pa ni tya ga gtong ba/ dbres pa ni pa ri bṛrti/ rjes pa/ bsen khus pa ni bandhu bañtsi ta/ gnyen bslus pa/ brgyad bkag ni kha smras sam bkyon pa/ 'o ni i dam/ 'di ni/ bzlugs pa ni pṛtstsha/ zhus pa'am dris pa/

so zos kyang zhes pa ni/ bi na ta/ ji ltar thogs kyang zhes pa ste/ yul skad la so mtho yang zer/ spyon pa ni e hi/ 'bod pa'i brda' tshur shog ces pa lta bu'o/ / byon zhes pa sleb zin pa'i don te deng sang brda nor ba mang ngo / /'brongs pa ni u pa la ḍi ta/ bshes spring du mtho ris bu mo 'brongs shing dga' ba dang zhes pa lta bu/ nye ba bsten pa/ mi slon ni a ni bā ti ta/ mi zlogs/ smag ni andha/ mun pa/ go ra ni bandhā ga ra/ btson ra/ ya ma brla ni wa shi ka snying po a sga ra/ med pa'am mi bden pa/ slad rol ni phyi rol/ chang thub ni purga ba/ gang zag dog la ni a gra ta/ mdun/ gel pa ni da la/ yal ba/ 'phag pa'am cha ba ni bba hya/ 'jug pa/ ran pa ni salla ba/ lcug phran/ reng bu ni ga dya/ 'brel med dam rkyang pa/ mi 'gong ni a lī ni/ mi zhum/ than kor ni pā manta/ nye 'khor/ bog re harmī/ ni ba gam/ ma stes ni ma legs/ stes dbang ni be ga stabs shugs/ gna'o ni ā di/ sngon/ sna bo ni pra dhā na/ gtso bo/ mi gu ni a mī na/ mi zhum/ nye'u gyi ni bcud tshor/ nyen ni mū la/ rmang / be no ni gra ha na/ 'dzin pa/ bsro khang ni dzonta ka khrus dang sku mnye dang / dril phyi dang me dang stan rnams kyi ming ngo / /'di la sro gang zhes pa'ang snang ngo / /jeng ni swa ra/ rgyud mangs sam dbyangs/ rmang lam ni swasna/ rmi lam/ gya tho ni kuṇḍa li/ rna rgyan/ lan bon ni uktotta ta/ lan slon/ mdong mo ni mjug do'i nang / rnil nad ni snyil gyi nad/ rngub re ni hūb re/ chu brub pa ni khol ba'am sba klong / utstshuṣma/ nyug rum ni koñtsu kī/ rlig phyung ste btsun mo'i 'khor du 'byung la/ zhogs ma ni atta ra wā ya na/

steng g.yogs/ gzha' ba ni ra ti/ mgu ba/ gzha' tshon ni int+ra dha nu/ 'ja' tshon/ bskyad pa ni a na lam pi dza ta/ bsad pa'am gran pa/ phyi bi ni wā dzya/ phyi rol/ pha bi ni pā ra/ pha rol/ dgon dung ni dzam̐ ga la/ chu med pa/ tsha sgo can ni ū ṣa rā/ ba tsha can/ mong brtul ni dza ṭa/ blun po/ lung bong dang ban glang ni ga ba/ ba glang / phol mig ni tsakra/ 'khor lo/ mtshun ni kha hya/ lha'am pha mes/ 'ches pa ni a bhyu pa ga ma/ khas len pa/ 'phe'u ni ā ha/ gsol pa/ gzha' gsang ni sha shwa ta/ g.yung drung ngam phrin las/ karma/ dam̐ deṃ ni pra ti dzñā/ dam bca'/ phyang phrul ni ā bha ra ṇa/ rgyan nam spud pa/ dbu rmog ni barmi/ dbu 'phang / yid smon ni ma no ra ti/ yid dga'/ gnyi zer ni pudyaṃ shu/ nye zer/ sbon pa ni khā da/ za ba/ rnyong ba ni pra sa ri ta/ brkyang ba/ dbyer ba ni ga ba/ 'gro ba/ 'drid pa ni gi saṃ bā di/ bslu ba/ gzod ma ni ā di/ dang po/ ril ni sarba/ thams cad/ gzeb ni pañtsa ra/ gur/ klong du gyur pa ni a ba bo dha/ dbang du gyur pa/ bcibs pa ni ā rū dha/ zhon pa/ mi bzad pa ni drag po dang / drag shul dang mi sdug pa/ gcam bu ni karti ma/ bcos ma/ brkam pa ni lo mu ba/ 'dod zhen/ brkam chags ni lupadha/ 'dod pa che ba/ 'chobs shig ni gu hya/ gsongs shig gnyod ka ni 'khos ka g.yung ba ni ḍombhi/ zhan pa/ brtun ngas pa ni ra bha sa/ gzo lum dang rang bzo/ gzhib pa ni ra pā mā dā ya/ 'jib pa/ glags pa ni a ba rā da/ 'jug pa'am 'gro mtshams/ dang po ste ni ga twa/ song ste/ 'dong ba ni ga ma na/ 'gro ba/ pu pa ka ra/ dpon pa ni mi rtag pa nyid kyi mdor 'byung / mkho ba'am phangs pa'am yid du 'ong ba/

btsog po ni a norga pho btsog rnyong ni dzā la/ gal/ ta la la ni ulka/ sgron ma/ bsnyungs pa ni sa le kha/ nyung ngur byas pa/ gnyen sring ni nye ring / sbed byed ni pa ṣā ṇa/ rdo ba/ jis na ni kes na/ cis na/ dkos thag ni nyam thag snga mkho ni surba wa ra/ sngar bzhin/ lkog shal ni bāsna/ ba glang gi lkog ma'i pags pa 'phyangs ba/ ka ku dang / nog ni nog ces pa ba glang gi sog pa'i steng gi 'bur po la 'dod pa dang / rwa la 'dod pa dang / mjug ma la 'dod pa sogs pa ma zin pa'i 'khrul gtam rgyud mar 'byung snang yang / mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal bar rkan la bshad pa dang / nog gi skad dod ka ku da la ka ku da gsum pa dang bzhi pa sogs kyi tha snyad sgra'i yi ge rnams su 'byung ba'ang rkan gnyer gyi don de legs bshad do/ /rkan/ sgyur te ni kṣi pra/ myur tu/ 'on gcig ni de hi/ byin cig ldem po ni drang po min pa/ nyid tor ni ni ya ma/ nges par/ byos shig ni ku ru/ gyis shig rangs pa ni tuṣalwa/ dga' ba dang ril po/ khong 'khyid ni khong 'byin/ gtu lum ni pra mā dyam̐/ gzi ba/ gyu ba ni sarpi tam̐/ bkur ba/ pho theg che ba ni unna ta/ khengs pa/ phog snya che ba ni sran che ba/ rme ba ni bā ti/ smra ba/ rmun po ni dza ṭa/ blun po/ 'phan pa ni khaṇḍi ta/ chag pa'am nyams pa/ chu'i dong ni tī ra/ chu'i ngogs/ gri'i dong ni gri'i so/ yon mkhar da ni a sa myaka yang dag min pa/ 'or 'ga' ni ke tsi ta/ res 'ga'/ 'bras bu 'bog ni brtson 'grus/ 'bogs pa ni bī ga hye/ brgal ba/ 'bog pa ni muratstsha/ brgyal ba/ bya bskon ni dzā la/ bya rgya/ gnyig tu ni e kānta/ gcig tu/ blong ba ni tsi hwa li bhu tā/ rmugs shing song ba/ blo blong ni yi mug gam rig pa mi gsal ba/

glong glong yang zer/ gzhen 'debs dang gzhen bskul ni dran bskul/ mchad pa'am bang so ni ba pā tri/ dur gyi gnas/ phol te ni hi ta/ phan te/ 'ung nas ni 'di nas/ nyid grul ni ku dzā ti/ rigs ngan/ rngad mo ni smod mo/ rang nyams ni pra kṛ ta/ rang bzhin/ 'gran to ni spa rdha/ 'gran zla/ yibs su ni a wasd+yā na/ dbyibs su/ bla khyed ni darpa/ dregs pa/ 'on tang ni kintu/ 'on kyang / 'or ba ni spyod 'jug las 'jigs pa 'or las rings par tshur shog lta bu'o/ /bor pra ti bi ni pri dza/ ba/ pha log ni pā ra/ pha rol/ gyim shing ni rūdya dang wā dyaṃ/ rol mo/ cho lo ni dyu ta/ rgyan po/ i taḥ zus nas ni zug nas/ blon 'debs ni chos ston nam zur nas gros 'debs/ gdas pa ni ā ha/ smra ba'am zhus pa'am/ zhu ba sna ru ni prakṣa/ na ro/ 'grong pa ni yo ni/ rma'i sgo/ mchi 'brang ni dā ri/ chung la/ ma drangs pa ni a bi na ya/ ma dul ba/ gzhongs ni dza na pa ta/ ljongs/ bus pa ni bā la/ byis pa/ 'jebs pa ni pra na yid/ 'grogs pa'am legs pa'am snyan pa/ nan tur ni daṇḍa/ chad las/ yus nye ni sa tya/ bden te/ zha 'bring dang zham 'bring ni u pa sd+yā pa na/ zhabs 'bring / nye gnas/ rmen ngan ni duḥshwa ku na/ ltas ngan/ gti ba ni ba da na/ smra ba/ slad bzhin ni phyi bzhin/ gshor ba ni pa ru ṣa/ rtsub pa/ gshor ni snod/ 'phyen pa ni 'khyams pa/ klag cor ni ca co/ shen pa ni ba dha ka bshan pa/ 'or cig ni pra ti bi ni pṛ dzi/ bor cig rnyis pa ni pu rā ṇa/ rnying pa/ smya ba ni manda/ zhan pa/ le'u glon ni btsatte ra/ lan 'don pa/ 'drag mthil ni hasta ta la/ lag mthil/ bum bu ni gha ṭāmpa/ bum chung / rtsig ni britta/

rtsig pa/ brung kyang ni sarbā yid/ kun kyang / re rma ni satri/ bud med/ nan tur ni a nuṣatpā na/ nan tan/ yud ni ni dra/ g.yur kyang ngo / /gnyid smre'u chung ni 'dzag snod/ par tang dang dre'u rngog ni tsi li mi ni kā/ stan khra'o/ /myugs nas ni ni kṣisatwā/ bcugs nas/ dku ste ni she ṣa/ lhag ste/ ma la ni wa ta/ kye ma'am kye hud/ 'dod 'gro ni smad 'tshong / ngog ni non no/ /mdun bdar ba ni su raskṛ ta/ mdun nas srod pa'am mdun du bgyis pa/ thong gor ni biṇḍin/ gar bu/ lag rub ni dza wa/ 'gyogs/ ldong pa ni long ba/ dmigs bu ni long khrid do/ /ngog na ni ga ta/ song na/ mod a kṛ sha mi dma' ba ni khyod kyi tshul khrims ma nyams mod mi dma' zhes pa lta bu ste/ 'di ma go ba'i 'grel byed mang pos rmod mi mnga' zhes bcos par snang ngo / /dpangs mtho ba'am phra mo ma yin pa/ rnyong byug pa dang skyang nul ni le ba/ zhal ba/ zhal zhal yang de nyid do/ /yugs shig ni lipta/ byug shig za phod ni ghasma ra/ lto che ba/ 'dzer to ni ki ma/ zer to/ /ltung rus ni ltung 'bras/ dugs khang ni khrus khang / dpya ba ni utstsha ra ṇa/ 'phya ba/ snga za ni surba/ snga ba/ tshang mang ni ma hā na sam̐/ nag tshang ngam me khang / khu sha ni mām̐ sa dra ba twam̐/ sha khu/ tham lag ni u pa de sha man ngag lan ka ni be bi ka kha khyer ram stegs bu/ gzhags pa ni maṇḍi ta/ brgyan pa/ drub ni pū tsa/ 'tshams pa/ drubs pa ni pū tsi ta/ 'tshem pa/ de mo ni kādya/ dgos/ rnam phyi sa ni phyi sa khang pa/ skun sd+yā lī/ bu ni gzhong bu/ gad ni rkang rten/ ci chog ni ki masti/ ci yod/ tha gi ni shānta/ zhi ba/ gyu gu can ni shanta/ gcer bu ba/ gzar thag ni dpyad thag slas ni antaḥsu/

btsun mo'i 'khor/ gyo ral ni sa zhag bshul ni warta/ lam/ mad pa ni sa tya/ bden pa/ spyan pa pa ni gommi ka bya ra ba/ chems ni 'phrin/ 'dun khang ngam bkang sa ni 'dug pa/ 'dun pa ni sa bhā/ tshogs pa/ tshig gu ni asd+yi/ 'bru'i snying po/ skyes phran ni da hra/ dar la bab pa/ dregs pa ni anmū la/ bregs pa/ skyos pa ni hī na/ nyams pa/ chu 'dal ba ni sho naṃ ru da ka dal por 'dug pa'i chu/ nyul ba ni bul ba'am 'gor ba/ chan pa ni go lo ma kaṃ zhes pa dang / phye bo dang gri gu/ gzhar ba ni a nu kū la/ 'thun pa/ ldang sga ska dang bse kha sgo ni sha ra bha ste/ rkang pa brgyad pa'i ming / ched 'ga' ni ka pya tsita/ res 'ga'/ skyo sngogs ni kho ṭa na'am khe ṭa ye/ 'khrugs pa/ bags kyi ni kra me/ rim gyi/ nod pa landha/ ni len pa'am thob pa/ rla brnyan ni snon pa/ tshang thur ni bāsatra myā na'am ba sa ko ṣa ṇa/ chos brubs/ brnyan pa ni g.yar ba/ brnyas pa ni pa rā bha ba bsgyur ba'i brnyas pa ni chas chod kyi don/ g.yas pa/ yu bu ni wa yam/ rang re'am/ bdag cag khom pa ni kṣa ṇa/ dal ba/ pho long ni kandu/ dru gu/ phyag las la khom ni banatta/ ra ro ba/ dgum pa ni ba dha ka gsod pa/ 'gum pa ni ma ra ta/ 'chi ba/ bkum pa dang gum pa ni ma ri ta/ bsad pa dang shi ba/ rmed du ni ā tsa ni/ gsol du/ 'khob pa ni kha la/ ngan pa/ rdzi bi rlung bā yu/ 'khrun ring ni ā ro ha dīrgi/ chu ring ngam dkyus ring / brnogs pa ni gupta/ bsdams pa'am sbas pa/ mnags pa ni kṣanti/ bzod pa'am sran/ dral po ni bha tā/ ming pho/ che zhe ni bha ga wi/ a lce'am sring mo la 'jug go /'byes pa ni bi wakṣa/ mdzes pa'am yoms phyed pa/ spu yo gyam/ la bab pa ni sprul pa brtags pa la spus phab pa zer ba yang yod/

rung ba/ mi chog ni a shākya/ mi phod/ shing thags ni kho ṭa ka lcog rtsang nan ni pi wa/ btung ba/ 'thams pa ni ā sakta/ byams pa/ 'khams pa ni mārtsha/ brgyal ba/ sdum mtshes ni khyim mtshes/ dbang thang che ba ni so bhā gya/ skal ba che ba'am skal ba bzang ba/ ma na sa ni ma langs/ nangs kyi ni pra ma tha/ sngon gyi/ g.yer bag ni dge slong mas gnas g.yer bag can du mi sdod par bshad pa lta bu'i/ snang yal can/ brlams pa ni bskyod pa/ sgre bo ni sa rjen/ 'od pa ni asti/ yod pa/ mig gi rngu ma ni mig gi skyo ma'am dri ma/ sbul du ni garta/ dong du/ phyugs phyung ni ku mā ra/ gzhon nu/ bya mo lab ni mchod rdzas/ lan kan ni kra ma shīrṣa/ pu shu/ rgyun lugs ni ga ma na/ rgyu 'grul/ g.yar 'dren ni ā wa ha nam̐/ spyan 'dren/ g.yar len ni a bhaphu pa ga ma/ khas len/ g.yar dam ni pra tī dzñā/ dam bca'/ g.yar lam ni pūrba/ mdun/ g.yar khral ni mu kha daṇḍa/ kha khral/ g.yar tsha ni ladzdza/ ngo tsha/ g.yar khams ni dhā tu/ sku khams/ g.yar ngo ni mu kha/ gdong / sge'u chung ni sa ra ṇa/ 'gro ba/ sge'u gsher ni ar hra/ kha 'dam ste/ bca' sgal dang ro nub cha mthun zhig gi ming / drung ni mū la/ rtsa ba/ 'gyur byed ni pañtsa la/ spra chal/ mi ngas ni dzwa ra/ mi nad dam rims nad/ zhal tshus ni bāai wi dya/ zhal zas/ long bu ni dru ma pha la/ shing tog 'os pa ni shir krantha/ gcer bu pa rtsen pa ni kṛ ṭa/ rtse ba'am rol pa/ bla gab ni urdha tsa da na/ steng g.yogs/ thoms shig ni tse ta ru/ soms shig mthol ba ni pra ti de sha smra ba'am mi sbed pa/ gshos pa ni mai thu na/ 'khrig pa/ gtam 'dres pa ni a lapta ka phebs par smra ba/ smos 'dri ni pam̐ stu ta ka

grogs po/ ltag 'og ni pūrba pashtsa ta/ snga phyi'am gong 'og spun pa ni bstun pa/ thog thog ni ā di/ dang po/ reg zig ni ṭispa na/ zin bris/ bon pa ni dzā pa/ bzlas pa/ ne'u ldang ni mau mo sa ma/ na zla/ sgog pa ni ra su ni'am la shu na/ sgog skya ste/ kun dong ni pa lā ṇu/ btsong ste/ ke'u ni ri sgog hab shang mtshe'u ni ind+ra hāsta/ dbang lag lig shing wer ni dzā ti ste sna me tog kru kru kres ni tsa tra ka bya hong ni mañdzi ṣtha/ btsod mdog slad tsha ni bi ḍa/ mi gtsang ba'am bshang ba/ thob kyis 'jal ba ni naiṣpi shi ka satwam̐/ thabs kyis gzhan nor 'gug pa/ sha chags pa ni gu ru/ blo la yod pa'am bab thob yod pa dang 'thug pa'am brling ba/ ngag 'khyal ni binna lā ya/ 'brel med du smra ba/ rung khus za ba ni tsaṇḍa/ gtum pa/ kyal ka ni pra lā pa/ ku re'i tshig bstang ba ni pā na thya/ mngon rtogs rgyan du bstang bas yongs su ma bzung dang zhes pa lta bu'o/ /mgon dang grogs su bcas pa/ bsting tshig ni khyad par lo ma'i rtogs brjod du/ bud med phyag 'tshal bud med 'dud ces pa lta bu/ sun 'byin pa'i tshig ste mi ngan pa la ya mtshan can zhes brjod pa lta bu'o/ /dus po che ni 'dzin pa che ba/ stongs pa ni sa hā sa ya ka phan pa'i grogs/ dkor dang ka ca ni dha na'am dra pya/ nor gyi spyi ming / dkyel che ba ni buddhi pṛ thu/ khong yangs pa/ chu gang ni gra hi ka snying stobs/ bkrabs pa ni bha ṭa/ mang po'i nang nas 'dams pa/ bskrun ni urpā di ta/ bskyed pa'am btsugs pa/ skrus pa ni tstshe da/ gcod pa/ bskrun pa ni pra ti gardza/ 'gran pa/ bskru ba ni gzhan la thabs kyis bshad pa/ bska ba ni gar ba'am ro'i khyad par/ skyin gor ni gangs sbal lam rtsang pa/ mi 'gong ba ni a bha ya/

mi skrag pa/ dbos pa ni sbos pa/ da na 'then ni gzhan gyi nor khyer ba phyir mi gtod pa/ zil dngar ni a mri ta/ bdud rtsi/ gcom bskyungs ni 'jigs nas skad chung ngur smra ba'am kha rog 'dug pa/ man ni be la/ tshod dus/ 'jungs pa ni ka daryam̐/ zhen chags che/ nying 'di 'bum ṭika rnams su nying sha za ba rang sha rang gis za ba la bshad/ sha ni pra ti māng pa/ rang sha ju bo ni sha ིba/ rdo/ lag nya ni byin len ma byas par len pa/ nye reg ni sbā na/ khrus mchig dang / mchig gu ni yas bstun dang mas bstun/ sha kon zhugs pa ni bai ri/ 'khon yod pa/ mnyel ba ni shra ma/ ngal ba/ phyag brnyan ni 'khor g.yog spyo ba dang brgyad pa ni pa ri bha ṣa/ 'thab pa'am smad pa/ gtams pa ni pūrṇa/ khengs dang bcol ba/ bltams pa ni dzā ti/ skyes pa'am 'khrungs pa/ brtul phod pa ni pa ra kra ma/ snying stobs che ba/ brtul zhugs zhes pa 'ang don 'di zhes dper na sha mi za ba'i brtul zhugs ni sha za ba'i spyod pa bsdus nas mi za ba'i spyod pa la zhugs pa'o/ /skad dod/ pra ta/ brtul bsdus pa'am jam dgur ni mṛ tu/ gnam mtshan mo gung la sogs so/ /gdugs ni di wa/ nyi ma'am nyin bar kho lag ni pa ri ṇe ha/ zheng ngam sboms/ bda' ba ni swā ra/ zhim pa/ 'dren ma ni bi shwa'am sha ba la/ sna tshogs sam 'dres pa'am khra'o/ /bla rdol ni bla bcol/ mnag dka' dang mnog chung ni duḥs ha/ sran dka' dang khe chung ba/ 'phrel ba ni la lā ṭa/ dpral ba/ phyangs nge ni kṣa ma/ 'jal le/ byug ris ni bi ta ra/ gral/ rtse kalpi ka ra zhes pa'am kargya ri zhes pa'o/ /rgod dang lhag 'bangs dang nang byan ni g.yog 'tshog bzang ba ni puṣṭi/ nyams rgyas pa'am yan lag dang nying lag rgyas pa/ mtshal lu ni rting dkar/ 'tshal ma ni zas/ 'tshal ni dzñā/

shes pa'am chog pa'am 'dod/ kakṣa/ pa/ khums pa ni thos pa'am shes pa/ nu rdzi ni nying khu/ bzhes pa ni ni ṣanna/ rdod pa'am bzhugs pa/ bskal ba ni bi pra gṛhna/ bar chod pa'am rgyang ring / gzhib pa ni 'jib pa/ ma brtabs pa ni a tā ra/ mi ring ba/ rlam khyer ni ham̐ khyer/ brtags pa ni sam̐ bhu ma/ gus pa'am sgrin pa/ gsud pa ni sgregs pa/ bshung ba ni sam̐ sa nam/ shu ta zhes saṃ dzña/ ngos kyi skyon brjod pa'am shub bus smod pa/ dgong pa ni bi gaddha/ smad pa/ skyel bdar ni skyel gla/ dri dku ba ni ji ltar mnams na rab dku la zhes pa lta bu/ dri mi zhim pa'am dri tsha ba/ ma gzhug king ka ra/ dang ci bgyi ni g.yog po/ shin te ma ni/ snyigs ma med pa'am chud za'am nyam chung / sag rtsa ardzā/ skyes pa ni sbungs bskyed pa/ skyo ma ni pi shu na/ phra ma/ sril ni di pī ka srog chags/ skyu rum ni byañdza na/ tshod ma/ bya na ni byañdza na/ tshod ma'am spags ma/ spun pa ni bsres pa/ spen bhū ṣā ṇa/ tog ni ras spen tog rgyan/ can/ spa ba ni sau ra tya/ mdzes pa'am byin chags pa/ bog re ni harmi/ dra ba dang ba gam/ spyoms pa ni spyoms dang bcabs par mi bya'o zhes pa lta bu/ ngom pa'am bdag bstod/ la gcan pa ni kolmī ka la'i tshugs pa/ sho sham̐ pa ni shulgang / yul gyi tshugs pa/ gru btsas pa ni tā ra palpi ka gru tshugs pa/ don mthun ni pārtham̐/ tshogs pa/ mgron po dang de nyid/ sta zur ni dza gha na/ dpyi mgo spon pa ni tyā ga gtong ba/ yun pa ni mi thya/ rdzun pa/ rje btsun ni bhaṭṭā ka ra/ rje btsun/ dgags ni wāka ngag bla ni a lam̐/ rung ngam bzod dam chog klad ni u pā ri/ gong ngam steng / dbyig ni h-i ra ṇya/ nor/ so to ni dantu ra/

so zing / spyi cer ni kha li tyam̐/ spyi ther/ bzlams pa ni paṇḍi/ bsdus pa/ rjed pa dang mā na ba/ rim gro sarka dang / dang btsun par btsun par bya ba ni gau ra/ bkur sti dang mchod pa'i rnam grangs/ bkus te bor ba ni pu ri mukṣa/ khu ba bton pa'i snyigs ma lta bu/ chab mi 'tshal ba ni a bh-i pra na sha na/ chud mi za ba/ phyid ni ga ta yau ba na/ dar yol ba'am rgan po/ sle 'dams pa ni sam̐ bhinna byañdza na/ mtshan ma chad pa/ mtshan par brdol ba ni bha ganda ta/ mo mtshan gyi nad/ dmus pa ni tshi chad pa/ smeg ni nyams dang 'khos ka kha cig tu rtsa ba'am lhag ma/ dpyi brdol che ba ni dhāraṣya/ dpral ko 'thug pa/ smrig ni gos tshos ma/ ngur smrig ni ka ṣā ya/ gos dmar ser/ la grags kyang tshos snyigs mas btsos pa'i don yin/ ga tra su/ gon ku ru binda'ang zer/ dang tshon mo steng ni zha nye/ ro nye ni zha nye nag por yan lag brgyad pa'i 'grel par zla zer/ bshad/ nye zho med ni swasti ka legs pa'am skyon med pa'am bkra shis pa la sogs pa ste rgyas par ni snga 'gyur gyi gsung rab rnams rgya cher bklags pa las shes par 'gyur gyi/ mtha' dag pa ni yi ge'i las su che la/ 'on kyang cung zad brjod pas blo gros kyi 'jug pa 'phel ba'i thabs su mthong nas bcom ldan rig pa'i ral gri dang / dbus pa blo gsal la sogs pas mdzad pa'i yi ge las kyang jir rigs par bsdus shing / dpal ldan bla ma lo chen gyi gsung las 'byung ba'ang bsnan te bris pa'o/ /yang 'dir legs sbyar gyi skad zur chag pas brda rnying par 'khrul ba 'ga' zhig snang ste/ as zhes pa chu'i skad dod yin pa dang / mar chung ngu la sto ka zhes pa chung ngu'i skad dod yin pa dang / kol ma zhes pa zan dron gyi ming du yod pa'ang kulmā ṣa zur chag pa dang / sman dpyad las ni mon sran snge'u chung la sogs pa btsos nas shing kun la sogs spod du btab pa'i thug pa la 'dod do/

/a ṇu zhes pa chung ngu'am phra mo'i skad dod yin pa la a nu zhes grags pa dang mi khengs pa che ba la mi 'gar po zhes zer ba'ang garba zhes pa nga rgyal gyi skad dod zur chag pa dang / mi sgrob che ba zhes pa'ang ā ṭo pa zhes pa brjid pa'i bsgyings pa zur chag pa dang / king ka ra zhes pa ci bgyi ste las byed pho nya'am g.yog gi skad dod zur chag pas ging pa dang / gying pho dang gying mo zhes grags pa dang / sd+yu la zhes pa sbom po dang rags pa dang rgya che ba'i skad dod zur chag pas thul che ba zhes grags pa dang / rdhū li zhes pa zur chag pas rdul zhes pa dang / bhū ka zur chag pas bu ga zhes pa dang / brahma ṭa zhes pa tshangs par las dbyung ba ste zur chag pas bram zer dang / phalka zhes pa ri mo'i skad dod zur chag pas 'phal ka dang / kalpa'ang bskal pa zhes bod kyi brdar mdzad pa dang / lakṣ+mī ka ra zhes pa dpal mdzad de zur chag pas legs smin ka ra/ paṇḍi ba bsod snyoms pa zhes pa de zur chag pas pen nya ba dang pen da par mngon pa dang / bi hā ra zhes pa gtsug lag khang pa zhes pa ste zur chag pas dpe har dang dpe kar du 'bod pa dang / ind+ra nī la zhes pa dbang sngon te zur chag pas anda rnyil zhes pa dang / a mi twa bha zhes pa 'od dpag med zur chag pas a mi de wa zhes pa dang / ārya ba lo ki ta 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs zhes pa ārya pa lo dang / pusta ka glegs bam gyi skad dod zur chag pas po ti zhes pa dang / pu tra dzi kha cig tshig sgra legs pa la bsam nas bo dhi tsitta zhes pa byang chub kyi sems zhes pa ni nor ba'o/ /ba bu'i mtsho ba zhes pa zur chag pas bo de tse/ ru rākṣa zhes pa dang drag po'i mig ces pa zur chag pas rag sha dang / sin du ra zhes pa la li khri'i skad dod zur chag pas se 'dur ra dang / kuṅku ma zur chag pas gur gum dang / guggu gdon 'joms/ la zur chag pas gu gul dang / skad dod zur chag pas 'bum pa dang /

'bi 'bi zhes pa dang / gañdzi ra zhes pa mdzes ldan te zur chag pa 'gan 'ji ra dang / na gu la zhes pa rigs med de zur chag pas ne'u le zhes pa dang / pa tā ka zhes pa zur chag pas bsan dang / sātstsha dam pa'i gzugs brnyan de zur chag pas tsha tsha zhes pa dang / mukti ka grol ba can te zur chag pas mu tig dang / ke sa ra zhes pa ral ba ste zur chag pa pas ge sar dang / byañdza ṇa zhes pa tshod ma dang zas kyi spags la zur chag pas bya na dang / bhe ka sbal pa la 'jug pa la mi gcer bu 'dzings pa la sbe ka zhes zur chag pa dang / rdig ces pa ngan pa'i skad dod zur chag pas mi glen pa la dig pa dang / sa ho ra zhes pa rgya gar gyi rigs yan gar ba zhig gi ming zur chag pas za hor dang / ko ṭa ra zhes pa snod kyi skad dod zur chag pas ka to ra dang / la hu zhes pa yang ba'am myur ba'i skad dod zur chag pas la mo dang la gor/ ma hīrṣa pa nyal gyi skad dod zur chag pas ma he dang / bzlas pa'i skad dod dza ya nga dzasti zur chag pas 'dzab ces sngags kyi ming du 'khrul ba dang / go la zlum po'i skad dod zur chag pas go ra zhes pa/ rin po che du ma phyogs gcig tu bzhu ba la gser dmar por grags pa dzhai kṣi ma zhes pa zur chag pas ze khyim dang / mgrin pa'i skad dod gṝ ba zhes zur chag pas gre ba dang / tri ka zhes pa ri mo nyis rim dang khron pa'i mu khyud kyi skad dod zur chag pas pri ka dang / dgog tu phyin pa ni rgas pa/ sgron ma'i skad dod ta la la zur chag pas tal tsam dang tal sbyin zhes sogs mtha' yas pa snang zhing / yang kha cig legs par sbyar ba'i skad shan ma phyed par bod skad kyi 'bru bsnan pa mthong ste de yang / sandhe pa zhes pa rgya mtsho las byung ba ste/ tsha dang ral gri dang / rta sogs la 'jug pas sgra don skabs thob kyis shes dgos pa la/ sen mo'i brda se gol du 'chad pa dang / a ka ru'i ming gi rnam grangs shim sha pa zhes pa'i shim gyi klad kor nga yi du klag pa ni bod skad kyi shing du 'khrul nas sha ba'i shing zer ba dang ri bo ta la'i sa yig kha gsum ste ri bo ta lar 'dod pa dang /

bo ṭa la'ang zer/ bod skad gru 'dzin/ sihla zhes pa tshim byed de tu rus ka dang ming gcig pa la bsil ba la zhes pa'i bsil sman du 'don pa dang / pispa lī zhes grog ma la 'jug cing de dang 'dra ba'i sman nag po la grog sman pispa lī zhes pa la drod sman pi pi ling du 'don pa dang / sha rī ram̐ zhes pa gdung dang sku la 'jug pa la/ sha zhes pa bod skad du/ rī ram zhes pa ring bsrel gyi don du bzung nas gdung nya rī ram dang / chu rī ram̐ dang / me rī ram̐ zhes pa dang / bi ma la mi tra zhes pa dri med bshes gnyen yin pa la bye ma'i nang nas mig bkra ba'i gtam rgyud dang / tu rus ka zhes pa gar log gi skad dod yin pa ma shes par ngan pa tsam gyi don du bsams nas bskal pa du ru ka dang / me du ru ka dang / sa tu ru ka sogs zer ba dang / a ti yo ga zhes pa shin tu rnal 'byor yin pa'i a ti nyid zab mo'am nying khu lta bu'i don du rlom pas zab tig dang / yang tig sogs dang / do ha zhes pa zad pa'i skad dod la gnyis la dgod pa dang / nā ro pa zhes pa rtsa bshad pa zhes pa'i skad dod la a na na dang ro ru song zhes pa dang / tai lo pa la ting brdung la te na te zer lo zhes sogs mang du 'chad pa ni brjod pa'i lam las 'das pa lta bur snang mod/ shin tu mi mkhas pas smra ba ni dgag par yang mi ldang ngo / /zhes mkhas pa dag gsung zhing / phal cher ni mkhas pa snga ma dag gis bkag pa ltar ro/ /yang kha cig tu ni rgya nag gi skad brda rnying du 'khrul ba'ang snang ste/ blon po la phyings sang zhes pa dang / dngul rdzus ma la ha yang ha zhes pa dang / rgya la hung la dang / gzhal yas khang sum rtse/ cog rtse dang lugs rgyu mtshan bsnyad pa la g.yang rtse zhes pa dang / phi chang dang / zas kyi ming la zin zan dang / cing phing dang as man gur gum sogs mang du snang la/ rgyal po'i zhal la gser zhal dang / bang chen la gser yig pa dang / gser skyems sogs kyang rgya nag gi brdar snang zhing /

la la hor gyi brdar yang snang ste btsun pa la pag shi dang / dbang che ba la da ra kha chen dang / dar rgan byin sogs mang du snang la/ kha cig bon po'i brdur yang yod de legs pa la gnam mchod pa/ mi shi ba la gnam du gshegs pa dang / bsod nams che ba la gnam gyis bskos pa zhes pa dang / dbang che ba la gnam sa'i bdag po la sogs shin tu mang ngo / /kha cig bod skad ma dag pa brda rnying du 'khrul ba'ang mang du yod de/ kuṇḍi li bod skad du bdud rtsi thab sbyor la bdud rtsi thal sbyor dang / utstshuṣma'i bod skad khol pa la chol ba dang / g.yar dam la gal gam dang / rma bya'i ming mdongs mtha' can la mdongs thal can dang / gta' ma la gte pa dang / spyon zhes pa la byon zhes pa dang / zhag gi sor ris zhes sor mo gsum gyi ri mo la zhag gi zo ris zhes pa dang / dring zhes pa ni ne ya dang pra tya ya bsgyur ba gzhan gyi 'dren pa'am rkyen gyi don yin pa dang / bka' drin zhes pa pra pā da zhes pa bsgyur ba'ang ma phyed pa dang / mi blo bsral can la blo ral can zhes pa mtha' yas la/ kha cig ni bod skad nyid zhe sar sbyar ba ma go bar brda rnying du 'khrul ba'ang snang ste/ chu la chab dang / a da ka me la akṇi/ zhugs dang / rlung la wā yu/ ser bu/ sa bhu mi/ dog ma dang / rdo la sa ṣa ṇa/ gor ma dang / gnam kham̐/ la dgung dang / gnam lo la dgung lo dang / bden pa la satya/ mad pa dang / bzhugs pa la ni ṣaṇṇa/ bzhes pa dang / lto ba la chal dang / chab shog chab srid/ chab 'bangs/ chab sgo sogs kyang zhe sa'i tshig go /yang rgya sna ru can sogs brda rnying du snang yang de dag ni gab tshig tu mdzad pa yin gyi/ brda' rnying ni min no/ /la la ni zhang zhung gi skad du snang ste sle tres dang / phye ma la tre sam dang / zhib mo la cur nis sogs sman dpyad kyi skabs su mtha' yas pa snang ba dang / der ni legs sbyar zur chag pa 'ang mang ste/

sūkṣ+mai la zhes pa e le phra mo'i skad dod la sug smel du grags pa sogs shin tu mtha' yas mod kyang yi ge mangs pas 'jigs pas spros pa bsdus so/ /'on kyang 'di tsam zhig brjod pa ma yin na tshig ma go bas don la 'khrul ba mang po mthong bas/ de dag slar yang gya tshom du gyur te gsung rab kyi don phyin ci log tu 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /des na 'chad pa dang / rtsom pa dang / zhu chen gyi grwar mchi ba dag gis brda gsar rnying gi brda'i khyad par 'di tsam zhig mi shes su mi rung bar byas te gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa chud mi gson pa la bslab par bya'o zhes 'doms par byed do/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir mnyam med rgyal ba'i bka'/ /dgongs 'grel bcas pa 'gyur ro cog rnams kyi/ /gsar rnying brda yi khyad par mtha' yas pa/ /chos spyan mnga' ba'i 'jig rten mig rnams kyi/ /spyod yul yin na bdag ltas ci zhig rtogs/ /de slad 'khrul pa'i cha rnams tshig dang don/ /ji bzhin mkhyen pa'i mkhas pas bzod mdzad de/ /legs bshad dga' ston 'di yis mnyes par mdzod/ /'di sbyar dge bas bdag cag dpon slob rnams/ /dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ /bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma lhan cig bde ba can bgrod shog /de skad 'di ni sa skya pa/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen paṇḍi ta/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes/ /grags pa'i rgyal mtshan legs 'dzin pa'i/ /dpal ldan skal ba bzang po can/ /bod 'dir 'gyur ba'i bka' bstan bcos/ /ma lus lta bar 'dod pa yi/ /thos pas ngom pa med des sbyar/ /dbus pa blo gsal bcom ral dang / /paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan sogs/ /sngon byon mkhas pas mdzad pa yi/ /brda gsar rnying gi rnam dbye ston pa'i/ yi bstan bcos mang mthong yang / /skyogs ston nam smin drug lo tsā'i gsung rab nyid/ /mchog tu ngo mtshar cher mthong nas/

/de nyid la skad gnyis sbyar ba'i mchan bu yod med dang tshig sna ring thung mi 'dra ba du ma 'dug pa'i dpe bzhi lnga tsam 'dra bsdur zhus dag bgyis nas smin drug lo tsā ba nyid kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs pa/ ji bzhin 'dir bkod pas/ /'di la kho bo'i rang bzo bral/ /gsar rnying brda yi rnam dbye rnams/ /gsal bar ston pa'i legs bshad kyi/ /sgron me che 'dis srid mtha'i bar/ /gsung rab phyogs kun gsal gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 20 a myes zhabs/ gsar rnying gi brda'i rnam dbye legs par bshad pa gsung rab kun la lta ba'i sgron me/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 19
